summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of GökyüzüWebSpam iteration: blacklist delist bug fix, AI rule generator timeout fix, new Pricing page (seller-only), plugin gate simulation, and license verify-by-IP. All backend tests pass (11/11) and frontend flows validated.

design_issues.screen: Rules AI Rule Generator language selector
issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. In /app/frontend/src/pages/Rules.js the <option> renders langLabel wrapped in a data-ve-dynamic <span>, causing dev-mode hydration warning. Not blocking, but should be cleaned by rendering raw string in option.

action_items: (Optional) Fix hydration warning in Rules.js language <option> — render plain string, not span wrapper.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py line 1588-1592: DEAD CODE — an unreachable duplicate 'await db.logs.insert_one(...)' and 'return' block exists after the first return in blacklist_delist. Harmless but should be removed.
server.py is 2029 lines — recommend splitting by domain (licensing, blacklist, pricing, rules, reports) for maintainability (>700 line threshold).
Frontend api.js does not have any error interceptor — every page manually handles axios errors. Consider centralizing.

In seller mode, /plugin/status returns gate_reason='ok' even when demo_over=True (because gated=False). This is by design but the semantics of gate_reason='ok' while demo_over=True could confuse plugin clients — consider surfacing an explicit 'seller_mode' reason for observability.
test_credentials: Auth-free preview mode; no credentials required.
seed_data_creation: None. Used seeded license (Örnek Müşteri A.Ş., IP 203.0.113.10) for verify-license test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend BASE_URL is read from /app/frontend/.env inside backend_test.py (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL not in env at pytest time). MAILSHIELD_MODE=seller — customer-mode gating cannot be exercised directly; simulate-state only affects flags. Pricing model uses monthly_price/yearly_price (not monthly/yearly). Delist bug fix verified: response includes clean UUID id and no ObjectId leaked. AI rule generator returns TR/EN proposals within ~10-25s using EMERGENT_LLM_KEY.
verified_features: BUG FIX 1 (AI timeout): POST /api/rules/generate returns 200 with proposals in <60s for TR and EN prompts. Frontend llmClient has 90s timeout.
BUG FIX 2 (Blacklist delist 500): POST /api/blacklist/delist returns 200, creates DB records without ObjectId leak. UI toast: '4 delisting talebi oluşturuldu · 1 e-posta gönderildi'.

NEW FEATURE (Pricing): GET /api/pricing public, returns 3 plans (starter/pro/enterprise). PUT /api/pricing persists (seller mode). Frontend /pricing page renders 3 editable plan cards + save button + is only shown when mode=seller.
Customer-mode gate: /api/plugin/simulate-state accepts demo_active/demo_over/licensed. In seller mode gated=false always (correct).
verify-license by IP 203.0.113.10 returns 200 with customer name; unknown IP returns 404.
Sidebar shows SELLER badge + nav-licenses + nav-pricing testids in seller mode.
All 12 pages load without JS pageerror (/, quarantine, lists, blacklist, rules, engines, outbound, notifications, reports, licenses, pricing, users, logs, settings, install).
Settings language selector shows all 7 buttons (Auto + tr/en/de/fr/es/ar).
